comment: Pinned libmpv artifacts vendored by scripts/fetch-libmpv.mjs. `url` is OUR mirror (the 'vendor-libmpv' prerelease) — never an upstream link: shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake deletes builds after ~30 days, which broke the v1.0.94 Windows build when the pinned one vanished. `upstream` records where the bytes came from. To bump: pick a build deliberately (never 'latest' — daily upstream builds have a history of silent regressions), upload the archive UNCHANGED to the vendor-libmpv release (`gh release upload vendor-libmpv <file>`), pin its sha256 here, and re-test playback on that platform before committing.

macos-aarch64.source: eko5624/mpv-mac (self-contained libmpv.2.dylib, ffmpeg statically linked, GPL)
